reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-07-28 by re-opening primary issuer docs and an independent aggregator. Ondo available-assets still states USDon is 'backed 1:1 by a US dollar in one of Ondo Stocks' brokerage accounts'; investing-and-redeeming still states each USDon is 'backed by a dollar of cash or equivalents at an Ondo Stocks brokerage account' with instant USDon settlement in the invest/redeem flow. DefiLlama module 408 independently restates 'backed 1:1 by US dollars held in Ondo Global Markets' brokerage accounts' with 1:1 USDC mint/redeem. Because the issuer does not disclose cash-versus-cash-equivalent instruments or weights, the aggregate remains assetClass other at 100% rather than assuming pure cash. Trust-and-transparency still scopes Ankura daily attestations and first-priority security interest to tokenized-stock securities/collateral and 'Ondo Stocks holdings' at US-registered custodial broker-dealers, not to a USDon-specific cash-balance report. No public USDon reserve balance, named broker for USDon cash, account reconciliation, or independent USDon cash attestation was found on re-open.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ondo issuer product documentation for USDon cash-or-equivalent brokerage-account backing, re-opened 2026-07-28; DefiLlama module 408 mint/redeem description as independent corroboration
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current cash balances, brokerage identity for USDon settlement cash, cash-versus-cash-equivalent instrument weights, account reconciliation, provider allocation, custody terms for the USDon cash sleeve, and any USDon-specific reserve assurance remain undisclosed in the re-opened sources.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ondo documents that all Global Markets holdings sit with one or more US-registered custodial broker-dealers and that the issuer is a dedicated BVI SPV with an independent director and full segregation of assets, books, and accounts from Ondo Finance Inc. and the Ondo Foundation group; that supports a structured bankruptcy-remoteness posture at the entity level. Not known: the identity of the broker-dealer(s) holding USDon settlement cash, account titles, whether USDon cash sits in segregated or omnibus accounts, any SIPC or private insurance coverage, and rehypothecation terms. Ankura Trust's first-priority perfected security interest and daily verification are documented for tokenized-stock collateral, and whether either extends to USDon's brokerage cash is unstated. No USDon-specific attestation or report exists, and Ondo's disclaimer states the issuer and tokens are not registered or licensed by the BVI FSC, SEC, CFTC, or any financial regulator.
